_readme: KEY DIFFERENCE from the Squadrons profile: throttle goes to the RIGHT
TRIGGER (rt), not the right stick. MSFS lets you bind an axis to a trigger,
and triggers are absolute 0..1023 values, so your throttle lever position
maps 1:1 to throttle setting. That is the closest you get to real HOTAS
In-game: Controls > filter to Throttle > bind 'THROTTLE AXIS' to the right
trigger. Do NOT use the default incremental throttle up/down bindings, that
is what makes a lever feel wrong.
Rudder on the twist axis (rx). If you later add pedals to OPi A, move rudder
there and free rx for camera/view.
